name: NOROO Holdings Co., Ltd.
summary: NOROO Holdings Co., Ltd. operates as a general fine chemical company in South Korea. It produces industrial materials, such as paint, ink, resin, and coatings; and color chemicals used in automobiles and building interiors, as well as offers plastic products. The company is also involved in the distribution, processing, sale, and seed cultivation of agricultural products; investment; agricultural life related; seed production; and transportation intermediary agency and brokerage businesses. In addition, it offers color academy and consulting, trend show and seminar, and trend book businesses; manufactures and sells thinners; and operates logistics business.
